name: Tensor Trust
description: Tensor Trust is a dataset and benchmark for studying prompt injection attacks on instruction-following large language models. It contains over 126,000 human-generated adversarial prompt injection attacks and 46,000 prompt-based defenses collected from an online game, enabling evaluation of model resistance to prompt extraction and hijacking attacks.
reputation: A notable benchmark for prompt-injection and jailbreak-style robustness research on instruction-following LLMs.
notes: Largest dataset of human-generated adversarial examples for instruction-following LLMs; includes benchmark results showing model vulnerabilities.
